events.title: Winter carnival setup crew
events.description: We need help hanging banners and setting up the game booths before the carnival. Wear sneakers for the gym floor. The PTA is bringing coffee and bagels.

events.title: Season opener 5K
events.description: First club 5K of the year, untimed, one loop of the park and back to the boathouse. You can bring one friend. The lot fills by 7:45, so street parking on Elm Ave is your backup.

events.title: Bed prep work day
events.description: Turning compost into the raised beds and fixing the two broken frames on the east side. Bring gloves and a shovel if you have one, we have a few to lend. If it rains we move to Sunday at the same time.

events.title: Spring cleanup
events.description: Meet at the Elm Ave lot to pick up bags, grabbers and vests. Teams split between the 100 and 200 blocks and we should wrap by noon. Older kids are welcome with a grown-up.

events.title: Plant sale
events.description: Seedlings from our own beds: tomatoes, peppers, herbs and perennials divided from the front border. Most pots are $2 to $5 and cash helps. Money raised goes toward the water bill.

events.title: End-of-year picnic
events.description: Bring a blanket and a dish to share. The PTA covers drinks and paper goods, and grandparents and siblings are welcome, up to three guests per family. If it storms we move into the school gym.

events.title: Track night
events.description: Members only tonight, the school asked us to keep the list tight. Easy 400s and 800s by pace group, no spikes on this surface. Use the side gate on Maple St.

events.title: Block party
events.description: The street closes from 1 to 9. Grills at the north end, chalk and kids' games at the south end. Bring a side or dessert and your own chair, and up to four guests per household is fine.

events.title: Tomato tasting
events.description: Bring a few ripe tomatoes from your plot, labeled with the variety if you know it. We slice, vote on favorites and save seed from the winners. Bread and salt provided.

events.title: Back-to-school ice cream social
events.description: A chance to meet teachers and other families before the first full week. Ice cream is free. Room parents will have volunteer sign-up sheets at a table by the front doors.

events.title: Hill repeats
events.description: Six to eight repeats on the north hill, walking down to recover. Meet at the bench at the bottom, the warm-up jog leaves at 7:30 sharp. Members only.

events.title: Seed swap
events.description: Bring seeds you saved this summer in labeled envelopes. Take what you can use even if you did not bring any, there is always plenty. Extra envelopes and pencils on the table.

events.title: Leaf raking day
events.description: Rakes out for the sidewalks, plus a few yards for neighbors who can't manage their own this year. The association has bags, bring a rake if you own one. Piles go to the curb for the city pickup.

events.title: Fall harvest party
events.description: Costumes optional, nothing too scary for the little ones. Pumpkin decorating, cider and a cakewalk. Suggested donation is $5 per family for classroom supplies.

events.title: Holiday craft morning
events.description: Kids make ornaments and cards in the library meeting room, all materials provided. Dress for glitter. Space is tight, so two guests per family at most.

events.title: Frosty miles
events.description: Three or five miles depending on how icy the paths are. Wear layers, gloves and a hat. Afterward we warm up in the boathouse with hot drinks, members only for this one.

events.title: Pi Day bake sale
events.description: Pies, cookies, anything round. Drop off baked goods in the lobby by 8:30 with an ingredient card for allergies. Most items are $1, proceeds go to the math club.

events.title: Spring work day
events.description: This year the focus is fresh woodchips on the paths between rows and fixing the gate hinge. Wheelbarrows are in the shed. Plot holders can bring one helper.

events.title: Spring 10K group run
events.description: Two loops of the park plus the river path out and back. Pace groups at 9, 10 and 11 minutes per mile, nobody gets left behind. Water table at the boathouse at the halfway point.

events.title: Spring cleanup
events.description: Same plan as last spring, but we are adding the alley behind the 200 block. Gloves and bags supplied, bring your own water. Rain date is the following Saturday.

events.title: Field day volunteers
events.description: Volunteers run the stations: sack race, water relay and tug of war. Expect to get wet. Check in at the table by the field gate to get your station.

events.title: Solstice potluck
events.description: Longest day of the year, so we eat in the garden until it gets dark. Bring a dish made with something you grew if you can, plus your own plate. Bug spray recommended.

events.title: Block party
events.description: This year the bounce house goes in the middle of the block, away from the grills. Please sign up for a shift at the drinks table. The street is closed to cars until 9.

events.title: Sunrise run
events.description: Meet at the river path entrance on Elm Ave for an easy 4 miles as the sun comes up. Members only. Carry water, the fountains along the path are not always on.

events.title: Seed swap
events.description: Our second swap. We are also collecting flower seeds for the school garden, so bring any extras. There will be a sorting table for beans, squash and greens.

events.title: Bulb planting
events.description: Planting daffodils and tulips along the Maple St median for spring. Dues cover the bulbs, so bring a hand trowel and a kneeling pad. Please park on the side streets.

events.title: Fall harvest party
events.description: Back in the gym with a costume parade at 4:30 and a chili table run by fifth grade families. Instead of a fee, bring a canned item for the food pantry drive.

events.title: Garlic planting
events.description: We break apart heads from last year's harvest, plant the cloves in the shared bed and mulch with straw. Takes about two hours.

events.title: Turkey trot practice
events.description: Dress rehearsal for the trot: same 5K distance at a steady pace. Members only. We will sort out carpools for race morning after.

events.title: Winter meeting
events.description: Yearly meeting for the 100 and 200 blocks. On the agenda: dues, the block party date and the speed bump request. Members only, and one person per household is plenty.
events.venue: Maple St branch library community room

events.title: Spring potluck
events.description: Bring a dish to share. Plates and tables provided.

events.title: Saturday long run
events.description: 8 to 10 miles at conversation pace.

events.title: Spring fling family dance
events.description: Music, crafts and pizza for families. Children need a place too; babies under two do not count.

events.title: Book fair volunteers
events.description: Two-hour shifts at the book fair tables.

events.title: Seed starting workshop
events.description: Trays, soil and seeds provided.

events.title: June social: planning meeting
events.description: Planning for the June social. Volunteers and hosts.

events.title: Spring cleanup
events.description: Litter pick and bulb weeding. Gloves and bags provided; carpools leave from the lot.
